description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Rear Leaf Springs Seats/Plate.
These are used to Attach the Front Leaf Springs to the Rear Axle.
LH & RH Sides Included!
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – LH Rear – Leaf Spring Plate
Qty 1 – RH Rear – Leaf Spring Plate
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
